title: Distributed Tracing
description: Implement distributed tracing with trace propagation across services, span collection, and trace querying.

steps.title: Trace propagation
steps.description: When a request comes in with an x-trace-id header, propagate it to downstream service calls.
hints: Extract x-trace-id from incoming request headers
Generate a new trace ID if none is present
Forward the trace ID in the x-trace-id header when calling downstream services

steps.title: Get trace by ID
steps.description: Create GET /trace/:traceId that returns all spans associated with a given trace ID.
hints: Store spans in a global map keyed by traceId
Each span should have service name, duration, and parent span info
Return the spans array for the given traceId

steps.title: Span details
steps.description: Each span in a trace includes service name, duration in milliseconds, and an optional parent span reference.
hints: A span is a unit of work with a service name
Record start and end times to compute duration
Parent span ID links spans to create a hierarchy

steps.title: List recent traces
steps.description: Create GET /traces that returns a list of recent trace IDs.
hints: Maintain a list of trace IDs as they are created
Return the list sorted by most recent first
Limit to a maximum number of traces (e.g., 100)
